first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark gray-black handgun in the lower-right foreground of the first-person view, with a rectangular slide; the grip area is occluded by the hand.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person in the small room behind the wall, with gray-white hair and wearing a long white coat, a blue shirt, and khaki trousers, sitting with head lowered and knees bent.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: Large rectangular wall panels ranging from light gray to blue-gray, with narrow gaps between the panels and rows of dark-colored rivets; the nearby wall occludes the small room behind it.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: The dark gray-brown floor beneath the passage and the small room, with regular grid-like divisions and repeated textures within the grid cells.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: The dark gray panel surface above the interior, with multiple parallel layered trim strips along the top of the wall.
